subject: Demolition - Pier 61 - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Demolition - Pier 61 - Vancouver Harbour
Demolition of existing pier in Burrard Inlet in the vicinity of 49 17.450N 122 57.017W.
Hours of operation 1400 to 0030UTC 17 Aug 2026 to 01 Mar 2027.
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Channel 64A. 
Minimum wake.
